public_measurement.state_centres: For directededge e and spatialbin j of countceil(length_e/50), centre isxy_u+(j+.5)/bins_e*(xy_v-xy_u). Allvelocityclasses sharecentre.
public_measurement.source_support: KDtree/measurement nodes derive ONLY from selectedsourcefold-excluded graphnodes. No actualqueryroadsegment ID, heading, velocity or trajectory.
public_measurement.initial_prior: Globalstart prior=(startGlobal+onegeometrypseudostart)/(totalStarts+1). Geometrymeasure usescellwidth and distributes mass over availablemotionclasses within thatroadcell. Localstart prior=(startHour+10*globalPrior)/(totalHourStarts+10).
public_measurement.initial_vector: aO proportional to initialPrior_h * exp(-distanceToO^2/(2*30^2)) within90m; normalize if positive. Unknownorunsupportedsource -> explicitfallbackflag.
public_measurement.destination: LD(s)=exp(-distanceToD^2/(2*30^2)) within90m, no normalizationrequired for endpointlikelihood. Stopdensity is rh*LD.
public_measurement.direction: Integrate possible directedroadstates; never force the completed-sourceHMMfirst/last labels onto an unseenquery. Do not interpret nearest1 agreement as annotatedaccuracy.
